newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX buoyed by futures, resists Dow fall.
newsitem.headline: German DAX buoyed by futures, resists Dow fall.

text.p: German shares were largely flat in early bourse trade as a rise in the DAX futures market provided some insulation from overnight losses on Wall Street.
The DAX-30 index of leading German shares rose 2.40 points to 3,398.35 in early dealings, with June DAX futures reversing late Wednesday losses to trade 34.0 points up at 3,404.0.
"It's mainly down to the rise in futures, which in turn was a bit surprising," said one dealer, adding that a firmer dollar at just under 1.72 marks was also helping trade.

With little corporate news or economic data scheduled, dealers expect trade to be range-bound for the rest of the day. German state inflation data coming through on Thursday morning had little market impact.
Early volumes were dominated by Germany's top three banks, with Deutsche Bank up 90 pfennigs at 90.95, Dresdner flat at 55.20 and Commerzbank up 40 pfennigs at 46.70.
Carbon and graphite producer SGL Carbon rose 9.90 marks to 246 marks in early trade as U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch said it was initiating coverage in the stock as a buy.
